provider_impact: NONE; CUSTOMER AND KEETA HANDLERS REMAIN UNBOUND AND NO PROVIDER CREDENTIAL OR ENDPOINT IS ADDED

expected_behavior_change: The trusted Android bridge accepts only mfp.store-kernel.command.v1 and mfp.store-kernel.submission.read.v1 for formal business traffic.
Direct browser store.kernel.commit.v1 is rejected before Store Kernel mutation.
Unknown commands and aggregate or canonical-state injection fail closed.
Submission replay is readback-first and fingerprint conflicts cannot create a second effect.
Trusted native handlers can attach an immutable revision read set that is validated inside the same Room transaction before any commit effect.
CHECKOUT_PAYMENT_CONFIRM derives one canonical non-Student cash Order and Payment transaction from trusted fresh native facts while the public production bridge remains fail closed.
Outbox acknowledgement and release require the positive attemptCount returned by the current claim so stale callbacks cannot mutate a newer lease.
Electronic tender records staff-confirmed visual-review evidence without claiming provider verification or storing a screenshot; cash records counted-cash evidence.
Parent Owner authorization is device-bound so logout revokes descendant staff access on that device without revoking independently authorized devices.

The Android runtime can request a native formal quote and submit CHECKOUT_PAYMENT_CONFIRM only through the high-level formal bridge; canonical tender choices are returned from the same fresh tender-policy read.
The V2-reference schema proposes stable posTenders IDs for Cash, Alipay, WeChat Pay, FPS, and PayMe; Admin V3 publication/readback support is still required and Octopus/card are not enabled.

The native producer can atomically project a validated active envelope and POS_TENDER_POLICY in the same Store Kernel transaction; policy rollback/conflict rejects and historical Payment tender references are preserved, but production Admin V3 source binding remains frozen.
Native print replay is fenced by dispatchAttemptId and payload identity, and OTA install recovery validates bytes before persistence while preserving AtomicFile backup recovery.
Canonical Dining state has a Room read producer only; no Dining mutation planner is registered.
The browser Store Kernel bridge exposes health only and rejects direct aggregate snapshots, receipts, inbox, and outbox operations.
non_goals: No client Order Pricing Payment Refund Dining Capacity or Print authority.
No second Store Kernel database or localStorage business truth.
No v2local runtime or SMM authority import.
No second transaction authority, fake COMMITTED, public bridge activation, live charge, Candidate Publish, deploy, OTA activation, cutover, merge, or SMM deletion.
